name: IVR
tagline: International association representing interests of European inland waterway transport sector
hero_kpi_rationale: En tant qu'association sectorielle sans activités commerciales, IVR ne dispose pas de KPI financiers traditionnels (marge brute, revenus). L'indicateur pertinent est le niveau d'engagement des membres, reflété par le nombre de participants aux congrès annuels (225 participants en 2024 provenant de 11 pays) et aux colloques spécialisés, qui mesurent la pertinence et l'impact de l'organisation.

kpis.explanation: Number of participants from member countries attending the annual IVR Congress.
kpis.signal: Strong member engagement with 225 participants from 11 countries at 2024 Frankfurt Congress
kpis.description: L'édition 2024 du congrès annuel de l'IVR, qui s'est tenue à Francfort du 15 au 17 mai 2024, a rassemblé 225 participants provenant de 11 pays européens. Cet événement majeur marque l'engagement continu des membres et des parties prenantes du secteur de la navigation intérieure.

kpis.name_fr: Participation au colloque de prévention des sinistres
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium addressing damage prevention in inland navigation.
kpis.signal: Successful launch of specialized event with 80 participants from three countries
kpis.description: Le premier colloque de prévention des sinistres de l'IVR s'est tenu à Anvers le 4 novembre 2024, rassemblant environ 80 participants de Belgique, des Pays-Bas et d'Allemagne pour discuter des aspects techniques et financiers de la prévention des dommages dans la navigation intérieure européenne.

kpis.explanation: Number of European countries with active member representation in IVR governance and activities.
kpis.signal: Pan-European representation across 11 countries demonstrates international scope
kpis.description: Au congrès 2024, l'IVR a réuni des représentants de 11 pays européens différents, reflétant son mandat d'agir en tant qu'organisme neutre et indépendant de représentation internationale (paneuropéenne) des intérêts de la navigation intérieure.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or digital transformation initiatives in the 2024 annual report. As a trade association focused on regulatory representation and knowledge exchange in inland waterway transport, IVR does not position itself around AI technologies.
evidence: No AI, machine learning, or automation initiatives mentioned
Focus limited to regulatory compliance (CESNI standards), safety culture, and sustainability
Organization mandated to represent interests through committees and international cooperation rather than technology innovation

_validation: Confirmed sector 'Non-Profit & Industry Association' - IVR is a trade association, not a commercial enterprise
Confirmed tagline accurately describes international association representing inland waterway transport sector interests
Confirmed hero_kpi 'Member Engagement' - appropriate for non-profit association without commercial revenues
Confirmed all 3 KPIs are valid and sourced from annual report
KPI 1: Annual Congress Attendance value 225 confirmed - source states 'Anneke Kooiman, begrüßte 225 Teilnehmer aus 11 verschiedenen Ländern' (welcomed 225 participants from 11 different countries)

Confirmed unit types: 'Participants' and 'Countries' are factually accurate, not fabricated

company_description: Tenaris S.A., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and supplies steel pipe products and related services for the energy industry and other industrial applications in North America, South America, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and the Asia Pacific. It provides steel casings to sustain the walls of oil and gas wells during and after drilling; steel tubing for conducting crude oil and natural gas to the surface after drilling has been completed; steel line pipes to transport crude oil and natural gas from wells to refineries, storage tanks, and loading and distribution centers; and mechanical and structural pipes for the transportation of other forms of gas and liquids under high pressure.
